metadata.copyright: SpektraLab research data. Not a spektrafilm profile; no array is derived from one.
metadata.datasource: HARMAN technology Ltd, "MULTIGRADE RC PAPERS Technical Information", June 2019 (MULTIGRADE-IV-RC-Papers-060619.pdf): characteristic curves for filters 00-5 (raster charts, p3), ISO R / ISO P tables (p2), spectral sensitivity chart (p1, no ordinate scale).

provenance.density_curves_model: FITTED to the sheet curves: three emulsions (one per channel), each a sum of three normal cdfs
provenance.log_sensitivity: SHEET shape (one curve for the whole paper, ordinate taken as linear relative sensitivity: ASSUMED) split into a shared blue part and a green part scaled per emulsion (split edge and green speeds FITTED; per-emulsion sensitivities are not published)
provenance.channel_density: ASSUMED spectrally flat silver in all three channels: neutral image tone (the sheet says Cool/Neutral for MGIV RC De Luxe and gives no spectrum)
provenance.base_density: ASSUMED flat 0.06 (the sheet says Cool/Neutral base and gives no number)
provenance.log_exposure_origin: CHOICE: 0 = the exposure a Tri-X mid-grey negative gives at filter 2, landing on Y = 0.184

info.name: ILFORD MULTIGRADE IV RC De Luxe (feasibility fit)
